meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂目标拆解成有依据的步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂目标不知如何拆分
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex goals into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to break down complex goals

howto.what: 把你的任务变成一套有证据、有检查点的执行循环：先注册目标，再拆成细步骤，每步留证据并更新计划；涉及代码修改时交给子代理并独立检查。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”、“ulw”等关键词，或要求做证据导向、带检查点的长期任务时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 模式帮我完成这个项目
say.note: 会先注册目标并拆解步骤。

say.text: 以 ulw 模式运行，先定义目标和成功标准
say.note: 按 define-goal 流程创建目标。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 执行代码修改，并做好手动QA
say.note: 会调用子代理并记录证据。

howto.what_en: Turns a task into an evidence-bound, checkpointed loop: register goal, break into fine-grained steps, record evidence for each, update plan; for code changes, delegate to subagents and verify independently.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions “ulw-loop”, “ulw”, or asks for durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Run this project in ulw-loop mode.
say_en.note: It will register the goal and break it into steps.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode: define the goal and success criteria first.
Execute the code changes with ulw-loop and do manual QA.
say_en.note: It will delegate work and record evidence.
